scripts.setup: python -m venv .venv && node scripts/py.mjs -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.build: node scripts/py.mjs -m compileall -q rsvp_template_media templates_app media_app outbox
scripts.lint: node scripts/py.mjs manage.py check && node scripts/py.mjs manage.py makemigrations --check --dry-run
scripts.start: node scripts/py.mjs manage.py migrate --noinput && node scripts/py.mjs manage.py seed_templates && node scripts/py.mjs manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:8002
